snippet.title: Night Turns to Day... | Teaser Trailer 2
snippet.description:
You play as a struggling Cartoonist who works for a large greedy TV network. You have been recently tasked with creating a new colorful cast of characters for your failing show. The stress of work, and some questionable things your boss says lead you to believe your creations may have come to life. Each night you must fend off each of your creations in any way possible as you slowly start to lose your mind. Maybe you're going insane, maybe it's the copious amount of drugs… who knows…

Night Turns to Day is an indie point and click horror game where the player has to manage resources and complete various tasks to fend off enemies in order to survive. The game offers high intense action and thrilling gameplay, with many secrets waiting to be discovered… Do you have what it takes to survive each night?
